title: Regulation (EC) No 810/2009 (Visa Code), consolidated version of 28.06.2024: Article 3 and Annex IV
in_force: the consolidated version of 28.06.2024; later amendments, if any, are not reflected
verified_how: curl was answered with HTTP 202 and an empty body. The text was read on 2026-11-02 in a Chrome session that the repository owner (Meng Wong) directed Claude to drive; the text is the page's rendered text. The browser's own download did not complete, so the PDF/page was NOT saved to disk and this file is the encoder's transcription of what the browser returned; it has not been compared with the original. Commons guide §8 treats a bot challenge as a 'no'; a browser read was used here with the owner's agreement, and whether that is acceptable under the guide is for Michael to say.
notes: English, as published; the Visa Code exists in all EU languages.
